Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ open a complaint properly — Excuse me, I’m very sorry, but…
✓ soften it — There seems to be… · I’m afraid…
✓ ask for the fix — Could you possibly…? · Would you mind waiting…?
✓ say what is wrong with a meal — overcooked, undercooked, the portion, the service
✓ answer as the waiter — I do apologize. I’ll get you another one.
✓ write a fair restaurant review in four paragraphs
